# S369 — UI pass can write its renders to its run temp dir

*Proposed.* A cloud UI pass may write files only under its own run temp dir (for rendered views), as a claude-local read-only role may write its progress note (adj 348). It still may not change the worktree.

**Findings:** S241 (2026-11-16, run ork-20261116-015040-d93b): the UI pass (claude opus, read-only, plan mode) was denied two Writes to `~/.local/state/ork/runs/RUN/` and reported tool feedback: "plan mode allowed writing only a plan file, so renders/*.txt could not be produced". · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-16** — A cloud UI pass can now write its renders: with Spec.WriteDir set (cloud claude, role ui, read-only, run temp dir) Args emits no permission mode and uses --add-dir TEMPDIR, --allowedTools (reviewer read-only list, Skill, Edit and Write under TEMPDIR) and --permission-prompts none. Reviewer, architect, gate and spec check keep plan mode (adj 372 and 374). Verified by unit tests with mutation checks, go vet, gofmt, go test ./..., slicer check and adj lint; not run against a live claude.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

*Proposed.* The UI pass prompt asks for rendered views to check layout; plan mode blocks every write but the plan file, so the pass reviews without them.

## Failing tests

- `TestUIPassMayWriteOnlyItsTempDir`: a cloud UI pass's args have no permission mode and allow Write and Edit only under its run temp dir (plus its allowlist, with `--permission-prompts none`); a reviewer's args are unchanged (plan mode).
- `TestUIPassWriteDirNeedsAbsolutePaths` and `TestUIPassWriteDirEscapesPatternCharacters`: the write dir must be absolute and clean and hold no comma; pattern characters are escaped.
- `TestClaudeRunnerGivesOnlyTheCloudUIPassAWriteDir`: the runner sets the write dir and the allowlist (read-only list plus Skill) for a cloud UI pass only (not a reviewer, not claude-local).

## Implement

1. Owner decisions (2026-11-16, adj 372 and 374, which supersede adj 371 and 370): the orchestrator probed claude 2.1 (haiku) on 2026-11-16: in `--permission-mode plan`, a Write under an `Edit(TEMPDIR/**)` allow rule with `--add-dir` returns "Cannot write to ... while in plan mode". Accept-edits mode is out too (adj 371: it auto-approves mkdir, touch, rm, rmdir, mv, cp and sed in the working directory). So drop plan mode for the UI pass only: run it with a read-only allowlist (Read, Grep, Glob, the read-only Bash rules a reviewer gets) plus Skill (adj 374, the pass loads skills) plus `Edit(TEMPDIR/**)`, and `--permission-prompts none`, so every other call is denied. Reviewer, architect and gate keep plan mode.
2. Red test, then the args.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
